note: Dated world events of the 2020s, generated by scripts/dev/gen-events-history.py from candidates verified against Wikipedia (scripts/research/verify-events.ts): the date of each was found in the cited article. Descriptions state documented facts only; effects are gameplay estimates from templates. Events fire only for listed countries that exist on the map; natural disasters and pandemics also fire in dynamic mode.
